query.text: 请陪我在医院候诊，我表达疑问或需要帮助时，请告诉我可以采取的措施。
query.text_en: Please accompany me while waiting at the hospital and tell me what I can do when I express a question or a need for help.

annotation.text_zh: 您可以去服务台咨询，或在手机上查看进度。
annotation.text_en: You can ask at the service desk or check the progress on your phone.

assistant_role_basis: 按任务归类，不代表可从画面确认设备硬件
